title: Recursive junta learner construction
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let a relevant-coordinate finder be given for dimension $n$ and parameter $k$, and let the rational failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. For every natural number of fuel, finite coordinate set $P\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and fixed sign assignment on $P$, the construction produces a randomized-example learning program returning either no decision tree or a decision tree whose available coordinates are outside $P$. With zero fuel, it maps the finder’s output to a leaf only when the output declares a constant; with positive fuel, it returns no tree for an absent decision, a leaf for a constant decision, and, for a relevant coordinate, recursively constructs the two branches with that coordinate fixed to each of the two signs and assembles them into a query tree.
